description: Source code for 'git show-branch' command, implementing branch visualization and comparison features.

classes.name: commit_name
classes.description: Structure representing a commit's name and its ancestor generation.

methods.name: interesting
methods.description: Selects a commit from the priority queue that is not marked as uninterested.

methods.name: commit_to_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name information associated with a commit.

methods.name: name_commit
methods.description: Assigns a name to a commit as the nth generation ancestor of a given head.

methods.name: name_parent
methods.description: Names the parent of a commit based on the parent's name and generation.

methods.name: name_first_parent_chain
methods.description: Names the chain of first-parent ancestors starting from a commit.

methods.name: name_commits
methods.description: Names a list of commits, assigning each a human-readable name based on their ancestry.

methods.name: mark_seen
methods.description: Marks a commit as seen if it hasn't been marked before.

methods.name: join_revs
methods.description: Joins multiple revisions into a combined set, marking interesting commits.

methods.name: show_one_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit's information, optionally including its name.

methods.name: append_ref
methods.description: Adds a reference to the list of refs to be processed.

methods.name: append_head_ref
methods.description: Appends a local branch reference.

methods.name: append_remote_ref
methods.description: Appends a remote branch reference.

methods.name: append_tag_ref
methods.description: Appends a tag reference.

methods.name: append_matching_ref
methods.description: Appends references matching a pattern.

methods.name: snarf_refs
methods.description: Collects references for heads and remotes.

methods.name: rev_is_head
methods.description: Checks if a given ref name matches the current HEAD.

methods.name: show_merge_base
methods.description: Displays merge base commits among a set of commits.

methods.name: show_independent
methods.description: Displays commits that are independent from others.

methods.name: append_one_rev
methods.description: Adds a revision or pattern of revisions to the list.

methods.name: git_show_branch_config
methods.description: Handles configuration options for show-branch command.
